priorities.title: Weight placement and demi-pointe proprioception
priorities.detail: Weight still in heels across all contexts — arches lifting but posterior bias persists. Upstream of pirouette axis, ankle instability, retiré mechanics, and allegro. Must be reliable on flat and in slow rises before pointe and jumps can return.

priorities.title: Outer hip and ankle stability under load
priorities.detail: Leaning away from barre and wobbling in relevé fifth. Standing side collapsing in adage. Gripping barre in rond en l'air. Left lateral chain still carrying compensatory load from right ankle recovery. Bilateral issue confirmed across barre.

priorities.title: Dynamic quality and opposition at the barre
priorities.detail: Accent, resistance, and floor pressure corrections appearing across tendus, glissés, grand battement, frappés, fondus, and allegro. Arms before legs in allegro. Coordination of arms and legs in pliés. The underlying pattern is passivity — not using the full music or full range.

themes.name: Weight placement and balance
themes.summary: Posterior weight bias in every context — barre, centre, pointe, allegro. Arches more lifted in June 25 but heels still anchoring weight backward. Root cause: forcing turnout from heels.

themes.name: Standing-leg stability
themes.summary: Standing side collapsing in adage, leaning away from barre in relevé fifth, gripping barre in rond en l'air. Left lateral chain weakness bilateral and confirmed across barre work.

themes.name: Retiré and passé mechanics
themes.summary: Retiré built foot-up rather than hip-down. Glute not activating to hold knee, knee not lifting, right hip rotating forward, working side pulling back.

themes.name: Pirouette axis and preparation
themes.summary: Axis collapses before pirouette finishes — closing in 3rd; arm-driven rotation; shoulder wind-up; passé dropping at 1.5 turns. Progress: good double May 2026, solid singles June 2026.

themes.name: Shoulders and épaulement
themes.summary: Trap dominance and shoulder blades riding up. Right elbow drops in second. Shoulder comes up in relevé. Ribcage needs to rotate forward in adage. Arms before legs in allegro. Shoulders tilting in fourth arms and in développé écarté. Right side back weakness confirmed on pointe as early as March 2026 — appears in pirouette en dehors turning left (right side back must snap inward to square) and en dedans (lacking strength generally); cross-exercise pattern, not isolated to one turn direction.

themes.name: Dynamic quality and accent
themes.summary: Passivity in arms-legs coordination, fondu resistance, frappé accent, and allegro drive. Arms and legs not arriving together in pliés. À la seconde extension needs active flexibility not passive stretch. Jeté passé must be compact and directional. Earliest noted in Discovering Rep adage (March 2026): relevé lent/battement height well below active capacity, addressed with active-flexibility barre stretch (leg on barre in second, lift with hamstring, not momentum).

themes.name: Hip lifting in développé/battement
themes.summary: Working hip lifting in développé devant, à la seconde, and grand battement to the side. Connects to pelvic alignment and left lateral chain.

themes.name: Pelvic tilt and core engagement
themes.summary: Posterior pelvic tilt mistaken for neutral — glutes and rotators not pre-engaged before exercises (notably batterie preparation June 25). Improving but proprioceptive sense still unreliable.

themes.name: Feet and arch strength
themes.summary: Arches lifting more (June 25 progress) but weight still in heels. Articulation through demi-pointe lacking across tendus, grand battement, and allegro. Bilateral winging on demi-pointe confirmed by physio. Earliest noted on pointe (March 2026): rises need active toe press into the shank for a clear ¾ pointe rather than a passive arrival.

themes.name: Upper back and shoulder mobility
themes.summary: Thoracic extension restricted — lumbar compensates in arabesques and backbends. Shoulder mobility affecting arms to fifth. Only starting to find back engagement in arms second this year.

themes.name: Musicality and expression
themes.summary: Teacher-named main priority for DR (June 15). Rushing phrases across barre and centre. Projection and looking outward still developing in centre work. This is the performing layer distinct from dynamic quality: timing, communication outward, responsiveness to the phrase.

themes.name: Technique
themes.summary: Correct-placement and basic technique corrections that do not tie to a recurring root-cause pattern — kept for completeness, not tracked as an exam-risk theme.
